en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a wide view of a military-style tent camp on open land with hills in the background and a small town in the distance. Numerous white canvas tents are arranged in rows, and several formations of boy cadets in dark uniforms stand in lines in front of the tents. At the top of the card there are handwritten archival notes, and along the bottom in red print is a caption describing the scene.
